name: Notification center and preferences

requirements.text: Account notifications and notification preferences are configurable.
Database notifications cover invitations, domain/webhook failures, usage thresholds, billing events, and admin broadcasts.
Users can filter unread/all notifications and mark one or all read from a dedicated notification center.
Mail delivery occurs only for a configured mailer and an enabled per-user category preference.

externalPrerequisites: Configured mail transport for optional email notifications

acceptanceCriteria.text: Database delivery remains available independently of mail configuration.
Notification links resolve only to objects the recipient remains authorized to view.
Unread counts refresh during Inertia navigation or bounded polling.

observedBehaviors: A right-aligned notification popover lists recent notification cards.
Unread/all filtering and a route to the full notification view are visible.

implementationEvidence.description: The final isolated Laravel suite passed 475 tests and 16,100 assertions with one conditional ClamAV-dependent skip, including notification preferences, delivery, read state, and administration coverage.
implementationEvidence.reference: docker compose exec -T -w /var/www -e APP_ENV=testing -e DB_CONNECTION=sqlite -e DB_DATABASE=:memory: -e DB_URL= app php -d memory_limit=512M vendor/bin/phpunit

implementationEvidence.description: The user notification center exposed unread/all filters and mark-read actions on mobile. The admin broadcast surface rendered at desktop and mobile widths; a regular user received 403 at /admin. Mail was not sent because the app uses MAIL_MAILER=log.
Independent regular-user review saved a changed Platform announcements preference and observed the success toast in the live notification region; the setting persisted.
implementationEvidence.reference: RegularUserUX-2 review; /notifications on disposable app http://localhost:8013

implementationEvidence.description: Independent admin UX/role review found no findings. The platform admin announcement form worked as a role-gated UI; ordinary users and workspace admins received 403 at /admin. No external mail was sent.
implementationEvidence.reference: AdminRoleUX review; /admin/notifications/broadcast on disposable app http://localhost:8013
